assertions.name: yekutieli_value_within_1_5pct_codata
assertions.source: λ_Yekutieli(q_0) = λ_A(q_0) − G·h(q_0)² evaluated at Q_50_DIGIT_STR at MPFR 50 dps. Expected ~2.4928 (1.33% from CODATA 2.4600). Family A baseline is 2.5328 (2.89% from target); Yekutieli improvement is ~2.2× by relative error.

assertions.name: q_locality_smooth_no_zero_crossing
assertions.source: λ_Y(q) = (3q² + 4 + 3q⁻²)/4 − G·(q − q⁻¹)² is a Laurent polynomial in q. Residual (λ_Y − target) is smooth across the q_0 substrate window; sign does NOT change in the swept range (q_0 ± 0.05). Distinct from PR #951's refuted form 5/2 − G·h² which had a zero-crossing at q_0.

description: Strategy I (Yekutieli per-cell curvature) probe — numerical verification of λ_Yekutieli(q) = λ_A(q) − G·h(q)² at q_0 + q-locality smoothness check. Distinct from PR #951's refuted `5/2 − h²·G` bare-replacement form: Strategy I is a categorical SUM (Family A PROVED + Yekutieli per-cell correction conjectural). No fitting; no production code change (Family A remains the sorry-free baseline). Bijection between H_4 half-symmetric Wedderburn projection and the 8 Borromean octahedral cells is the open research-grade piece.
caveats: RESEARCH-GRADE: this probe verifies the numerical value of λ_Yekutieli + q-locality smoothness, BUT the explicit bijection between H_4 half-symmetric Wedderburn projection and the 8 Borromean octahedral cells (the load-bearing categorical step) is OPEN. Production code does NOT swap Family A → Yekutieli until the bijection is closed sorry-free. Refs: docs/audits/2026-05-18-conjecture-proof-step3-yekutieli.md, docs/audits/2026-05-22-yekutieli-percell-conjecture-formalized.md.
